You can easily invest in HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth in a hassle-free manner on Groww. The
process is extremely simple, quick and completely paperless. Invest in a few minutes with the following steps:

Log on to your Groww account

Search for HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth from the search box

In order to invest, you will have to complete all the KYC formalities which are completely online and paperless
and take a few minutes to complete

Once you are done with that, you can start investing in HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth as SIP or lumpsum as per your
investment objective and risk tolerance

The HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth has been there from 01 Jan 2013 and the average annual returns provided by this fund is 10.40% since its inception.

The term Expense Ratio used for HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth or any other mutual fund is the annual
charges one needs to pay to the Mutual Fund company for managing your investments in that fund. The Expense Ratio of HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth is 0.20% as of 02 Nov 2026...

The AUM, short for Assets Under Management of HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth is ₹12,013.27Cr as of 02 Nov 2026.

If you want to sell your HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth holdings, go to your holding on the app or
web and simply click on it. You will get two options - redeem & invest more; click on redeem and enter your
desired amount or if you wish to redeem the entire holding amount then select the 'redeem all' checkbox.

You can select either SIP or Lumpsum investment of HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth based on
your investment objective and risk tolerance.

The NAV of HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth is ₹43.45 as of 30 Oct 2026.

The PE ratio ratio of HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund Direct Plan Growth is determined by dividing the market price by
its earnings per share and the PB ratio of the same is evaluated by dividing the stock price per share by its book value
per share (BVPS).
